description: Land Title Settlement Department - Suriyapaluwa, Mahara D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510810 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels. It includes detailed schedules with land parcel numbers, owner information, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances - all characteristic of land-related administrative matters as defined in Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
